div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Problem: Cache was populated from a stale replica.
Fix: Always read from the primary when populating the cache,
or use "read-your-writes" consistency by reading from
the primary for a short window after the write.
